_source_note: Real sub-items transcribed directly from PFRDA notification Advt. No. 03/2026 (03.09.2026), Annexure 'Syllabus for Paper 2 for General Stream (Common Syllabus for both phases)', pages 26-28. Companies Act chapter titles (III/IV/VIII/X/XI/XII/XXVII) are the Act's own real, public chapter headings, not invented. No sub-item is added beyond what the source states, except where a subtopic_id groups several comma-separated concepts the source itself lists together under one lettered item.
